selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080, rejects unrelated inbound
selected_evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --permanent config and live nft ruleset dump show public zone target=DROP with only tcp/22 and tcp/8080 accepted in filter_IN_public_allow, all other traffic hits reject-admin-prohibited
Both --permanent and runtime firewall-cmd --list-all outputs match (services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp, target=DROP) after firewall-cmd --reload
Captured boot_id 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d, firewalld running/active/enabled, sshd active, and the target rules in place before reboot
systemctl reboot was backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect; subsequent exec calls timed out confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 3a6c3b2f-c45e-42fb-ad23-80a8159135fa, differing from the pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of firewall and services
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, firewalld is active/enabled with target=DROP and services=ssh/ports=8080/tcp persisted, nft filter_IN_public_allow chain still only allows tcp/22 and tcp/8080, and sshd is active and listening

echo "== nft ruleset drop evidence =="

echo "== cleanup test listeners =="
kill "$(cat /tmp/http8080.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
kill "$(cat /tmp/http9999.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
